intent: Require one bounded native helper to author and self-validate every new or materially revised exact implementation-binding candidate, then return the joined result to bounded parent continuation without granting acceptance or effect authority.

required_conditions: exactly one bounded native helper authors and self-validates the candidate
the objective route and its authority ceiling remain unchanged
the parent independently joins and closes the helper
the parent retains final claims and the human owner retains acceptance
the parent re-enters CA2-ROUTE-ENTRY after the join
continuation is limited to remaining already-authorized work
continuation stops at the next authority, scope, safety, or external-effect gate
